title: Prayer For Anxiety And Fear | When Anxiety Won't Let Go, Give It To God
description:
A prayer for anxiety and fear, for the nights your mind won't stop asking what if.

What God says to an anxious person: David's crowd of thoughts, Jesus asleep in the storm, the birds of the air, and how to turn each worry into a request. Ends with a prayer for peace.

"Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus." Philippians 4:6-7 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 94:19, Mark 4:39-40, Matthew 6:26-27, Philippians 4:6-7, Psalm 56:3, Psalm 55:22, Psalm 46:10, John 14:27, Psalm 34:4.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
